app.name: NightAgent Call
app.short_description: What happened on the NightAgent call behind this ticket.
app.description: Shows the call summary, priority, caller, the tools Sam used, the call check, and the redacted transcript for tickets NightAgent made.
app.long_description: Read-only. For a ticket NightAgent made after an after-hours call, the sidebar shows the call summary, priority, caller name, each tool call in order (and whether it failed), the call check with rules and AI-judged items marked, and the transcript with phone numbers cut to the last four digits. Other tickets show a short note instead.
app.installation_instructions: Paste the NightAgent sidebar secret (the SIDEBAR_SECRET value from NightAgent's Vercel settings). It is stored by Zendesk and never sent to the browser.

sidebar_secret.label: Sidebar secret
sidebar_secret.helpText: The SIDEBAR_SECRET value from NightAgent. Hidden once saved.
